guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: The Company is updating some of its financial and operational guidance for the full year 2026 based on information available to the Company at the time of this release. This includes Centrus having:
•completed the manufacturing of its first centrifuge ahead of year-end target;
•finalized contracts with all of the supply-chain deemed critical ahead of year-end target; and
•completed the first certified-for-construction package ahead of year-end target.
For the full year 2026, on a consolidated basis, Centrus expects:
•Total revenue to be in the range of $450 million to $500 million
•Total capital deployment to be in the range of $350 million to $500 million, driven by increased investment in the Company’s industrial build out related to its centrifuge manufacturing
